title: Bikram Hot Yoga
specs: Heated room at minimum 105 ºF and about 40% humidity
26 posture sequence systematically works every part of the body
Arrive 25 minutes early for first-time students to register with valid ID
Drink lots of water for several days before class; need about 2 liters per day normally, double for Bikram yoga
Wear light, flexible workout attire covering private areas; men wear shorts or bathing suit, women wear exercise top and shorts or swimsuit
No eating within 2-3 hours before practice
includes: Yoga mat and water bottle (bring your own or rent/buy at studio)
gap: Class duration not explicitly stated for all classes
blurb: Guests practice a 26 posture sequence developed from Hatha Yoga in a room heated to 105 ºF with about 40% humidity. The practice systematically works every part of the body to maintain health and function, using heat to soften the body and flush out toxins through sweat. Certified instructors guide students through the scientifically designed series to enhance mind and body in 90 minutes.
extraNote: New student special: register online or drop in 25 min before class to sign up · Instructor schedules subject to change
